verdict.rationale: Aleph's own marketing says it can put "routine financial reporting and closing processes on autopilot" and offers "reporting automation", and its mapping agents "monitor your source data 24/7". That implies recurring automated workflows, but nothing shows a user actually defining or managing schedules. missing for 10: an explicit scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs (cron or interval configuration), scheduling of agent or AI workflows by the user, documentation of schedule management (run history, failure handling), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
